_: Phones area: Settings → Phones, where a person approves, denies or revokes the phones that asked to use this Headquarters.
_dynamic: Phones.State.* is resolved from the device state name (Pending, Active, Denied, Revoked).
Phones.Title: Phones
Phones.Intro: Phones that asked to use this Headquarters with your C-Sweet account. A phone can open your businesses only after you approve it here.
Phones.Empty: No phones have asked to connect yet. Open the C-Sweet app, choose this Headquarters and tap Connect.
Phones.Compare: Before approving, check that the fingerprint matches the one shown on your phone.
Phones.LoadFailed: Couldn't load your phones. Try again.
Phones.Changed: This phone changed while you were looking. The list has been refreshed.
